report: HR Clouds - Manager Panel Frontend & UI/UX Audit
method: API capture via direct curl (read-only GETs) + frontend JS bundle inspection, merged with a live-browser UI observation pass (read-only; no submit/approve/reject/delete clicked; DevTools unavailable so endpoints/console NOT VERIFIED). No screenshot files in the package (captures withheld: handoff bundle failed verification, several contain PII values).

findings.title: Same task, two priorities and two due times across endpoints
findings.observed: For one task id, /tasks/manager/team-tasks and /tasks/manager/{id} return priority 'high' and due_date '2026-10-15T05:00:00.000Z', while /tasks/me returns priority 'medium' and due_date '2026-10-15T04:30:00.000Z' (30 minutes earlier). One task, two priorities, two due times.
findings.expected_fix: Single source of truth for priority and due_date; normalize timezone conversion server-side so all task endpoints agree.
findings.ui_verdict: UI-confirmed and extended - UI shows the same task as Priority High in All Tasks/detail vs Priority Medium in My Tasks; kind also differs ('Rules & compliance' vs 'Joining a new person'). Detail renders '10:30 am', consistent with the team-tasks/detail due_date (05:00Z = 10:30 IST). See M-25.

findings.title: Team summary buckets double-count: absent 4 AND pending 4 for a 4-person team
findings.observed: final_absent_count=4 and final_pending_count=4 for a team of 4 members, while all 4 members are status 'not_marked' with status_reason 'pending_clock_in'. The buckets sum to 8, exceeding team size. final_present_count=0.
findings.expected_fix: Make status buckets mutually exclusive; members pending clock-in must not also count as absent (or document bucket precedence explicitly).
findings.ui_verdict: UI reframes - Dashboard shows NO 'Pending 4' (drops the pending bucket; counts reconcile to team size), but the semantic mismatch persists: dashboard says Absent 4 while the directory says 'Not Marked'. See M-26.

findings.title: Manager endpoint returns highly sensitive PII for a reportee
findings.observed: The employee-detail endpoint returns field names including pan_number, uan_number, blood_group, dob, personal_email, contact phone, current_address and permanent_address for a reportee, far beyond what team management needs. Values are deliberately not reproduced in this report.
findings.expected_fix: Role-scoped field filtering: return only team-management fields to the Manager role; gate PAN/UAN/blood-group/addresses/DOB behind HR-only access.
findings.ui_verdict: UI-confirmed - Profile page exposes PII field names (DOB, blood group, father's/spouse names, personal email, emergency contact, address details). PAN/UAN presence on the UI NOT VERIFIED. See M-28.

findings.title: Punctuality is 100% for months with zero present days
findings.observed: May-Aug 2026 return present_days 0 with absent_days 30-31, yet punctuality_percentage 100. The metric defaults to 100 when there are no present days (division-by-zero fallback).
findings.expected_fix: Return null / 'n/a' for punctuality when present_days is 0 instead of defaulting to 100.

findings.title: 'Leave' bucket folds holidays and weekly offs into leave
findings.observed: Own summary: on_leave_days 0 vs final_leave_days 6 (holiday_days 2 + weekly_off_days 4 = 6). Team graph 2026-10-02: on_leave_count 0 vs final_leave_count 4 with holiday_count 4, and attendance_percentage 100 with final_present_count 0. The 'final leave' bucket appears to include holidays and weekly offs, not just approved leave.
findings.expected_fix: Separate approved-leave counts from holiday/weekly-off counts, or label the composite bucket honestly (e.g. 'non-working days').
findings.ui_verdict: UI reframes - Member history renders Weekly off and Holiday as distinct statuses (not folded into leave) at row level; the API final_leave composite remains at the summary layer.

findings.location: Multiple attendance endpoints (team summary, daily log, history, weekly calendar, team-today, member history)
findings.title: Null-vs-zero inconsistency for the same 'no punch yet' state
findings.observed: For the same not-marked state, effective_hours is null (team summary members, weekly calendar today, member history, team-today) but 0 (own daily log, own history today); late/overtime are null (member history) but 0 (own history); total_hours is null (team-today) but 0 (daily log); member daily-log top-level shift is null while status_context.shift is populated.
findings.expected_fix: One canonical representation (null = no record; 0 = recorded zero) applied uniformly across all attendance endpoints.
findings.ui_verdict: UI reframes - UI renders 'N/A' / '0m' / formatted durations, so the null-vs-zero split is not visible to users; the API inconsistency remains.

findings.location: Team summary, team-today, task comments, department heads vs directory
findings.title: Avatar URL present in one endpoint, null in others for the same person
findings.observed: avatar_url is null for all 4 team members in team summary and team-today, null for task-comment authors, and null for all 3 department heads - while /organizations/directory returns signed S3 avatar URLs for the same people.
findings.expected_fix: Use a single avatar resolver across all endpoints so the same person has the same avatar everywhere.
findings.ui_verdict: UI reframes - UI renders directory photos for 3 of 4 members; fallback is inconsistent: header avatar is a solid purple circle with no initials, one member avatar is broken/partial (M-27), task-comment author shows 'AH' initials fallback.

findings.title: Numeric values returned as strings
findings.observed: total_days '1.00', leave balances '2.00', gross/net pay '21911.12'/'19164.45', total_hours '9.34', worked_hours '3.34', overtime pagination page '1' / limit '10' are all JSON strings, not numbers.
findings.expected_fix: Return numbers as JSON numbers; keep formatted strings only in separate display fields if needed.
findings.ui_verdict: UI-confirmed (formatting) - UI formats string numerics: total_days '1.00' renders as '1d'; balances as 'Xd' / 'Xd and 1/2 d'; payroll with rupee symbol, commas and 2 decimals (payslips) / Indian grouping, no decimals (salaries); durations as '7h 58m'. No raw string numerics observed on screen.

findings.location: Leaves, directory, attendance, tasks, task comments endpoints
findings.title: Pagination envelope has four different shapes
findings.observed: Observed shapes: {total, page, limit, total_pages} (leaves, directory); {total, page, limit, totalPages} (attendance, tasks); {page, limit, total_items, total_pages, has_next_page, has_prev_page} (task comments); own-history carries BOTH totalPages and total_pages.
findings.expected_fix: Standardize on one pagination envelope across the API.
findings.ui_verdict: UI note - UI renders a human pagination label ('Showing 1-25 of 30') in Team History; API envelope shapes remain an API-layer issue.

findings.title: Slow endpoints: trends 11.55s, several manager endpoints over 4s
findings.observed: GET /attendance/trends took 11.55s. Team-today 4.11s, member history 4.17s, member leave requests 4.34s. Median across 38 captured calls was about 1.9s.
findings.expected_fix: Cache or pre-aggregate trend data; profile the slow queries (team-today, member history, member leave requests).
findings.ui_verdict: UI symptom consistent - Leave history briefly flashes 'No History Found' before data loads (M-32), consistent with the slow member-leave-requests endpoint (4.34s); causation NOT VERIFIED.

findings.title: Approved regularizations carry no requested punch times
findings.observed: All 3 approved regularization requests have requested_clock_in and requested_clock_out null; reviewer object is null (only reviewed_by UUID); review_remarks null in 2 of 3. The approval records no corrected times.
findings.expected_fix: Require requested times at submission; embed reviewer name; require remarks on approval.
findings.ui_verdict: UI not observable - Regularizations queue EMPTY ('All caught up...'); row-level requested-times/reviewer rendering NOT observable.

findings.title: Error responses leak server stack traces
findings.observed: A 401 response body includes a full Node.js stack trace with server file paths (auth middleware, router internals).
findings.expected_fix: Strip stack traces from production error responses; log them server-side only.
findings.evidence: api-capture 01-team-summary.json from the first (unauthenticated) capture round

findings.title: Signed avatar URLs embed an AWS access key ID and expire in 300s
findings.observed: Directory avatar URLs contain an X-Amz-Credential access key ID and X-Amz-Expires=300. Credential material is exposed in API responses and the 5-minute TTL can break cached renders.
findings.expected_fix: Serve avatars via a CDN/proxy without credential material in the URL; use a longer, cache-friendly TTL.
findings.ui_verdict: UI note - UI renders 3 of 4 member photos; 1 broken/partial avatar (M-27). Whether the 300s signed-URL expiry contributes is NOT VERIFIED.

findings.title: Dead / legacy null headline fields
findings.observed: Team summary returns counts, team_size, eligible_headcount and attendance_percentage all null while final_* counts are populated. Team graph returns top-level month, year and team_summary null.
findings.expected_fix: Remove dead fields or populate them; do not ship null headline fields.
findings.ui_verdict: UI reframes - Dashboard renders computed counts (no null headlines visible); the dead API fields are not surfaced by the UI.

findings.title: Cancelled request included in the general team requests list
findings.observed: The team requests list returns 1 record with status 'cancelled'; the pending endpoint correctly returns []. Cancelled items are included in the general list, so clients must filter.
findings.expected_fix: Default the team list to active statuses, or document that clients must filter by status. Whether the UI filters is NOT VERIFIED (browser lane pending).
findings.ui_verdict: UI reframes - Team History SHOWS the cancelled request with a CANCELLED pill; Pending Approvals is EMPTY. The UI separates history from pending, so the 'must filter' concern is handled by separate views. No approver field anywhere in the leave UI.

findings.location: Overtime record policy_snapshot vs team-today policy_snapshot
findings.title: Policy snapshot variance for the same policy id (unconfirmed cause)
findings.observed: The same policy id shows full_day_min_hours 7.45 / max_break_duration 75 in current snapshots, but 7.00 / 60 in the 2026-10-06 overtime record snapshot.
findings.expected_fix: Verify against policy edit history: if snapshots are point-in-time, this is expected; if not, it is snapshot drift. Cause NOT VERIFIED.

findings.title: Seed-data quality typos and inconsistent canonical values
findings.observed: Department name 'Sales And Markerting'; overtime remark 'AproovaD'; timezone 'Asia/Kolkata' vs 'Asia/Calcutta'; city 'INDORE' vs 'Indore'.
findings.expected_fix: Correct seed data; validate canonical timezone/casing values on write.
findings.ui_verdict: UI-confirmed - Typo 'Sales And Markerting' IS visible in the Org Chart filter ('Sales And Markerting 2'); NOT in the directory. Location renders 'HEAD OFFICE' (all caps) in the UI.

findings.title: Derived rows carry null ids and null timestamps
findings.observed: History and team-today derived/provisional rows return id null and created_at/updated_at null.
findings.expected_fix: Omit id for synthetic rows or use stable synthetic keys; do not rely on id as a list key for these rows (UI usage NOT VERIFIED).
findings.ui_verdict: UI reframes - UI renders derived rows without leaking null ids/timestamps; no null literals observed anywhere.

findings.title: Current streak counts not-yet-clocked-in today as absent
findings.observed: current_streak is {type: 'absent', days: 1, since: '2026-10-14'} while the 2026-10-14 day status is pending_clock_in / not_marked.
findings.expected_fix: Exclude provisional / today-not-marked days from streak computation.
findings.ui_verdict: UI note - UI shows the same provisional-absent semantics: dashboard Absent 4 before clock-in while the directory says 'Not Marked' (M-26). Own-streak rendering NOT VERIFIED.

findings.title: Zero break minutes across 6 present days for one member
findings.observed: Member monthly summary shows total_break_minutes 0 across 6 present days (5 present + 1 half day).
findings.expected_fix: Verify break capture for this member; if breaks are not tracked, do not present a 0 that implies no breaks were taken.
findings.ui_verdict: UI note - UI Daily Log renders break duration when present (e.g. '1h 2m'); the specific 0-break member-summary case NOT VERIFIED in the UI.

findings.title: Anomalies use an is_resolved boolean and no status field
findings.observed: Anomaly records carry type / severity / is_resolved / resolver, with no status key - unlike leave and task entities which use status strings.
findings.expected_fix: Align status modeling across entities, or document the boolean convention.
findings.ui_verdict: UI-confirmed - Flags view shows no status pill/column, consistent with the API's is_resolved boolean; details truncated (M-33).

findings.title: Employee list requires a purpose query param
findings.observed: A bare GET returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR 'Purpose is required to filter employee data'. The frontend getEmployees passes caller-supplied params; whether manager screens supply purpose is NOT VERIFIED.
findings.expected_fix: Document required params in the API contract; consider a default purpose for directory-style reads.
findings.ui_verdict: UI note - Directory renders successfully (4 team members), implying params are supplied, but whether the UI passes 'purpose' is NOT VERIFIED.

findings.title: Login requires 'identifier', not 'email' (informational)
findings.observed: POST /auth/login with {email, password} returns success:false 'Identifier is required.' With {identifier, password} it returns success:true, role manager. The frontend complies with this contract.
findings.expected_fix: None - document the contract. Included because the first capture round failed on this field name.
findings.evidence: Capture-round-1 login response; capture-round-2 login success
findings.ui_verdict: UI note - Browser pass signed in successfully under the identifier contract.

findings.title: Directory is org-wide, not team-scoped
findings.observed: The directory returns all 8 org members (HR head, 2 managers, 5 employees) including DOB/email fields to a Manager caller, not just that manager's team.
findings.expected_fix: Scope the directory to the caller's visibility, or gate PII fields by role (ties to M-03).
findings.ui_verdict: UI reframes - UI Team Directory shows only the 4 team members (team-scoped); org total 8 visible in Org Chart. The API endpoint still returns org-wide data to a Manager caller (M-24 stands at the API layer).

findings.location: All Tasks / My Tasks / task detail views (UI)
findings.title: Same task shows different priority AND kind across views
findings.observed: The same task renders as Priority High, kind 'Rules & compliance', Deadline '15 Oct 2026' in All Tasks and in the task detail (detail shows '10:30 am', no timezone), but as Priority Medium, kind 'Joining a new person' in My Tasks. The detail time '10:30 am' is consistent with the team-tasks/detail due_date (05:00Z = 10:30 IST), not the /tasks/me value (04:30Z = 10:00 IST).
findings.expected_fix: Single source of truth for priority, kind and due_date across all task views; render the timezone on due times.
findings.evidence: browser observation, Tasks views (All Tasks / My Tasks / task detail). UI-confirms and extends M-01 (kind also differs in the UI).

findings.location: Dashboard KPI cards vs Team Directory list (UI)
findings.title: Dashboard says 'Absent 4' while the directory lists all 4 as 'Not Marked'
findings.observed: Dashboard KPI cards read Team members 4, Present 0, Absent 4, Late 0, On leave 0, Working 0 (no 'Pending 4'). The Team Directory lists all 4 members as 'Not Marked' with IN/OUT/Lateness N/A. The same not-yet-clocked-in state is labelled 'Absent' on the dashboard and 'Not Marked' in the directory.
findings.expected_fix: One status vocabulary across dashboard and directory: show 'Not Marked / Pending' on the dashboard before clock-in, or document that dashboard 'Absent' means not-yet-marked.
findings.evidence: browser observation, Dashboard + Team Directory. Reframes M-02 (dashboard drops the pending bucket) and M-19 (same provisional-absent semantics).

findings.title: Broken/partial avatar for 1 of 4 team members, with no fallback
findings.observed: 3 of 4 team members render photos; the 4th shows a pale circle with a small black arc - not initials, not a generic icon. The header avatar is a solid purple circle with no initials. The task-comment author fallback does render 'AH' initials, so fallback behaviour is inconsistent across surfaces.
findings.expected_fix: Robust avatar fallback: render initials (or a generic icon) whenever a photo fails to load; apply one fallback component everywhere (header, directory, comments).
findings.evidence: browser observation, Team Directory + header + task comments. Whether the 300s signed-URL expiry (M-13) contributes is NOT VERIFIED.

findings.title: Profile page exposes sensitive PII field names (DOB, blood group, father's/spouse names, personal email)
findings.observed: The member profile page (a full-page tab, not a drawer) exposes field names including DATE OF BIRTH, GENDER, MARITAL STATUS, BLOOD GROUP, FATHER'S NAME, SPOUSE NAME under PERSONAL PROFILE, and PERSONAL EMAIL, EMERGENCY CONTACT, ADDRESS DETAILS under WORK & CONTACT PROFILE. Field names only - no values are reproduced in this report. PAN/UAN fields were not observed on the profile page; their UI presence is NOT VERIFIED.
findings.expected_fix: Role-scoped field filtering on the profile view: gate DOB, blood group, father's/spouse names, personal email and address details behind HR-only access (same fix as M-03).
findings.evidence: browser observation, Member Profile page (field names only). UI-confirms M-03.

findings.title: Payslip NET < GROSS with DEDUCTIONS of zero, unexplained
findings.observed: Payslips render amounts with the rupee symbol, commas and 2 decimals, but NET is less than GROSS while DEDUCTIONS shows zero, with no visible breakdown explaining the difference. Amount values are withheld from this report (formats only).
findings.expected_fix: Show the deduction/LOP breakdown that explains NET < GROSS, or correct the deductions figure so the arithmetic is transparent.
findings.evidence: browser observation, Payslips screen (formats only, amounts withheld).

findings.title: Team Cost dialog: member cells blank, STATUS 'N/A' for all 4
findings.observed: In the Team Cost dialog, TEAM MEMBER cells are all blank and STATUS reads 'N/A' for all 4 members, while UNPAID DAYS shows '2d across the team'. The dialog renders no identifiable member rows.
findings.expected_fix: Populate member names in the dialog; resolve STATUS instead of 'N/A'; explain how the unpaid-days rollup is computed.

findings.title: Clicking a leave card opens no detail modal
findings.observed: Clicking the leave card in Team History opened no detail modal or drawer; there is no in-place way to inspect the request's fields. No approver field appears anywhere in the leave UI.
findings.expected_fix: Wire card click to a detail drawer/modal with the request fields, or remove the click affordance.

findings.title: Leave history briefly flashes 'No History Found' before data loads
findings.observed: The member Leave tab history briefly flashes the empty-state text 'No History Found' before the data loads and renders. Consistent with the slow member-leave-requests endpoint (4.34s, M-10); causation NOT VERIFIED.
findings.expected_fix: Show a skeleton/loading state instead of the empty-state text until the fetch resolves.

findings.title: Flags details truncated, with no status pill or resolution column
findings.observed: The Flags screen has 1 row: 'Unauthorized absence', Severity High, with DETAILS truncated (ellipsis). Columns are only EMPLOYEE / DATE / FLAG / SEVERITY / DETAILS - no punch times, reviewer, worked_hours, or status pill/column.
findings.expected_fix: Full-details tooltip or expandable row; add a status/resolution column.
findings.evidence: browser observation, Anomalies/Flags screen. UI-confirms M-21 (no status field for flags).

findings.title: Dashboard omits team-task section and pending-approvals counter
findings.observed: The dashboard renders KPI counts but has no team-task section, no pending-approvals counter, and no tasks-needing-attention strip, even though the team-tasks and pending-leaves endpoints return data.
findings.expected_fix: Add a tasks-needing-attention strip and a pending-approvals counter from the existing endpoints.

not_verified: Row-level rendering of empty Requests queues (regularizations, comp-offs, overtime): queues were EMPTY at observation time, so row-level null/reviewer/worked_hours/is_resolved rendering is NOT observable.
